claim.text: On the unchanged original D203 maximal-order 100-row evaluation at inert p5, the primitive trace radical is 37-dimensional and its secondary Schur quotient has unit ranks 36 and 1, yielding exact original v5(det G)=138 after 50 exact row divisions. The original unnormalized Gram modulo5 also factors through 25 weighted residue classes; if all residue-jet channels are spanned, its rank equals J times the count of classes with nonzero multiplicity mod5.
